title: Founder Live Operator Decision Ledger Readiness
objective: Define a governed local operator-decision ledger readiness boundary for future approval decisions without granting approval capture, persistence, DB writes, runtime admission, execution unlock, mutation, deploy, network, or spend authority.
safetyRules: No DB writes or hosted DB mutation.
No runtime admission or live mode transition.
No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
No full Command Center demo leakage.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence, audit, and activity helpers

knownLimitations: P109 is a decision-ledger readiness phase only until each subphase completes.

P109.1 does not capture operator decisions, persist approval state, write ledger records, write DB records, unlock execution, admit runtime execution, call providers/models, dispatch agents, run workers/tools, mutate projects, use hosted DBs, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
